jsonld_raw.name: LUNCHEON N21 MAGAZINE (ENGLISH)
jsonld_raw.description:
This magazine presents an editorial vision where fashion, art and contemporary culture engage in a free and experimental dialogue. The cover features Nikki Lilly, photographed by Jordan Hemingway and dressed in a creation by Matières Fécales, setting a provocative, conceptual and deeply creative tone from the start.

The Spring-Summer 2026 issue brings together fashion editorials from some of the most innovative brands and creators of the moment, including Paolo Carzana, Comme des Garçons and Matières Fécales, with imagery by acclaimed photographers such as Paolo Roversi, Jordan Hemingway, Laura Marie Cieplik and Tim Gutt. The publication pairs these productions with conversations and profiles dedicated to artists, writers and cultural figures such as Doris Lessing, Prunella Clough, Isabella Ducrot, Paul Thek and Beuford Smith, offering a broad perspective on art, literature and contemporary creation.

Beyond fashion, the magazine explores themes related to community, identity, gastronomy, photography and performance through essays, interviews and features such as Joy is Resistance, Capturing Community, Cooking for Ninety People and Studio as Art. Marc Springhetti’s paintings, featured throughout the edition, reinforce the artistic character of the publication and create a visual thread connecting its various sections.

With a creative direction committed to experimentation and interdisciplinary collaboration, this edition becomes an editorial object where fashion transcends clothing to converse with art, music, design and contemporary thought, solidifying its status as a reference magazine for those seeking an avant-garde vision of current culture.
